finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
finding.summary: An attacker-controlled workflow action string (e.g. "email.arbitraryMethod") flows unsanitized across 5 files - WorkflowStepController, WorkflowStep, WorkflowExecutionService, ActionResolver, and ActionDispatcher - where only the category prefix is checked against a registry while the method-name suffix reaches a dynamic `$handler->$method()` call unvalidated.
